laws.name: Washington Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and military-related exigencies. Funded through employer and employee contributions.

laws.name: Washington Paid Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides statewide paid sick leave for medical needs, family caregiving, public health emergencies, and safe leave related to domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking.

laws.name: Washington Family Care Act
laws.description: Allows employees to use their accrued paid leave to care for a family member with a health condition or emergency.

laws.name: Washington Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Leave
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims or family members affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking to seek medical care, legal assistance, counseling, or safety services.

laws.name: Washington State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Washington state employees for personal illness or injury.

laws.name: Washington State Employee Family Sick Leave
laws.description: Allows Washington state employees to use accrued sick leave to care for an immediate family member with an illness or injury.
